title: Read live availability and weekly coverage
summary: Understand free staff time, booked time, breaks, time off and running visits.

sections.title: Find the right person and day
sections.body:
1. Open **Team & availability** and choose **Location** and **Working day**.
2. Use **Team** for the directory, **Weekly coverage** for the week or **Time off** for upcoming absences.
3. Search with **Find a team member**. Combine **Show**, **Can perform** and **Professional role** filters.
4. Select a person to inspect today’s appointments, **Available booking gaps** and upcoming shifts.
5. Use **View calendar** to review the complete operational schedule.

sections.title: Understand the numbers
sections.body: **Available now** refers to free staff time today. A service must still fit its duration and required rooms or equipment. Reserved time includes reservations within usable working windows; it is not a payroll or attendance measure. A service running beyond its expected finish needs review before another client can safely be assigned.

sections.title: If someone is missing or appears off
sections.body: Confirm the location, date and filters; use **Reset filters** or **Everyone**. Check active status, working branch, weekly hours and dated time off. If **Availability needs refresh** appears, use the refresh control before assigning work. Where a display limit warning appears, inspect the full Calendar.

sections.title: Why colleagues see different coverage
sections.body: Managers see only authorized branches. Own-calendar staff see their linked working profile. Private leave reasons and login settings are not included in read-only coverage views.
